speaker: Doctor
text: The baby exhibits classic signs of respiratory distress including tachypnea, retractions, nasal flaring, and cyanosis. To differentiate between Hyaline Membrane Disease and Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn, I need to see the imaging findings. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
